full_name: Frances Kissling | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Frances Kissling, dubbed the “philosopher of the pro-choice movement” by Boston Globe columnist Ellen Goodman, is widely considered one of the more thoughtful proponents of international reproductive health rights.
